summary: Picked kinz-competitor-intelligence and kinz-margin-guardian-pipeline from the rotation (cursor 3). Both had their docs/IMPROVEMENTS.md deleted by the owner in early-October cleanup commits, so both were refilled fresh with 4-5 verified findings each. kinz-margin-guardian-pipeline: fixed a hard astk import in api/database.py/api/main.py that was silently skipping all 22 tests/test_api.py tests with a misleading reason; PR #28 merged clean. kinz-competitor-intelligence: fixed the seed-resurrection bug in scripts/seed_from_json.py (is_active hardcoded True); PR #71 opened but left unmerged because its Tests check hits a confirmed pre-existing, unrelated pyarrow/numpy<2.0 ceiling break in dashboard_smoke tests -- correctly not merged per the merge rules, left for maintenance.
